src-1793445528626-pit80.extracted_text:
Ministry of Education

## Ministry of Education organises Orientation-cum-Review Workshop on National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) to Strengthen Scholarship Implementation and Verification Processes

### Ministry Emphasises Timely Registration and Verification of NMMSS Applications for Academic Year 2026–27 NMMSS Provides an Annual Scholarship of ₹12,000 to Eligible Students

Posted On:
15 OCT 2026 3:46PM by PIB Delhi

The Department of School Education and Literacy (DoSEL), Union Ministry of Education, organised a one-day regional Orientation-cum-Review Workshop on the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, on Wednesday (October 14, 2026).

The Workshop focused on reviewing the progress of implementation of the Scheme, orienting officials on its mode of operation through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), and discussing issues raised by States regarding the verification of student applications at the levels of Institute Nodal Officers (INOs) and District Nodal Officers (DNOs).

The Workshop included detailed presentations and interactive technical sessions covering the implementation of NMMSS for the academic year 2026–27, including:

* Registration of fresh students
* Status of onboarding
* Application verification process
* Live demonstration of NSP processes for INOs and DNOs and
* Feedback and experiences shared by NMMSS student awardees.

The Workshop was led by Economic Adviser, DoSEL, Ms. A. Srija. Officials responsible for the implementation of the Scheme at the State, district and institute levels participated in the Workshop. Joint Director, Rashtriya Shiksha Kendra-cum-State Nodal Officer (NMMSS), Madhya Pradesh, along with approximately 40 District Nodal Officers (DNOs) and 5 Institute Nodal Officers (INOs) from Bhopal district attended the Workshop. Selected student beneficiaries of the Scheme and their guardians also participated in the programme.

The Ministry emphasised the important role of State Nodal Officers (SNOs), DNOs and INOs in ensuring accurate and timely verification of applications submitted by beneficiary students on the NSP for the academic year 2026–27. The last date for registration of applications for the academic year 2026–27 is October 31, 2026. The last dates for verification of applications at the INO and DNO levels are 15 November 2026 and 30 November 2026, respectively.

The interaction provided an opportunity for States/UTs to share their experiences in implementing the Scheme, identify operational and technical challenges, and discuss measures to improve the efficiency of registration, verification and scholarship delivery.

The Workshop also aimed to establish clear responsibilities at the State, district and institute levels and strengthen coordination among all stakeholders involved in the implementation of the scheme. The Ministry reiterated its commitment to ensuring 100% scholarship saturation and zero dropouts among eligible beneficiaries under NMMSS.

The NMMSS is a Central Sector Scheme aimed at providing financial support to meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections, with the objective of reducing dropouts after Class VIII and encouraging students to continue their education up to Class XII. Under the scheme, eligible students receive a scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum. The selection examination is conducted by the respective States/UTs, while registration, authentication and scholarship disbursement are undertaken through the NSP.

\*\*\*\*\*

src-1793445528651-1o6hw.title: NMMSS Scholarship Application Deadline Extended to October 31, 2026
src-1793445528651-1o6hw.extracted_text:
Ministry of Education

# NMMSS Scholarship Application Deadline Extended to October 31, 2026

### Eligible students will receive scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
01 OCT 2026 4:36PM by PIB Delhi

The Union Ministry of Education has extended the last date for submission of applications under the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) for the academic year 2026-27 to October 31, 2026. The extension will provide eligible students additional time to complete their applications on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and facilitate timely verification by the concerned authorities.

The revised schedule is as follows

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Process | Last Date |
| Submission of Application | October 31, 2026 |
| Institute Nodal Officer (L1) Verification | November 15, 2026 |
| District Nodal Officer (L2) Verification | November 30, 2026 |

The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) has been open for student applications since June 1, 2026. Students are required to complete their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the portal before applying for the Scholarship. As on September 30, 2026, 88,522 fresh and 1,97,133 renewal applications had been submitted.

Students who have already submitted their applications should ensure that the applications are verified by the concerned Institute Nodal Officer (L1) by November 15 and District Nodal Officer (L2) by November 30, 2026.

NMMSS is aimed at supporting meritorious students from economically weaker sections and encouraging them to continue their education beyond Class VIII up to Class XII.

The scheme provides one lakh fresh scholarships every year to eligible Class IX students who qualify in the selection examination conducted by the respective State/UT Governments. The scholarship is subsequently continued from Classes X to XII through renewal, subject to the prescribed academic requirements.

Eligible students studying in state government, government-aided and local body schools, receive ₹12,000 per annum, which is transferred directly to their bank accounts through DBT.

For appearing in the selection test, students must have secured at least 55 per cent marks or equivalent grade in Class VII, with a 5-percentage point relaxation for SC/ST students. The parental income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3.50 lakh per annum.

\*\*\*\*\*\*

src-1793445528678-biqq0.title: Eligible students may apply for National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme by August 31, 2026
src-1793445528678-biqq0.extracted_text:
Posted On:
06 AUG 2026 8:44PM by PIB Delhi

The last date for eligible students to submit fresh and renewal applications under the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS), for 2026–27 academic year, is August 31, 2026. The applications are to be submitted on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

The verification of applications under NMMSS is carried out in two stages:

Level-1 (L1) Verification: By the Institute Nodal Officer (INO) – last date: 15 September 2026.

Level-2 (L2) Verification: By the District Nodal Officer (DNO) – last date: 30 September 2026.

Further, from 2026–27 academic year, students may apply for one merit-based scholarship scheme and one or more welfare-based scholarship schemes simultaneously, subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria prescribed under the respective schemes.

The central sector Scheme was launched with the objective of awarding scholarships to meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections to reduce dropout at the secondary stage by encouraging them to continue their education after Class VIII.

Under the Scheme, one lakh fresh scholarships are awarded every year to eligible students studying in Class IX, with renewal of the scholarship in Classes X to XII, subject to the prescribed conditions, for studies in state government, government-aided, and local body schools.

All eligible students are advised by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Union Ministry of Education, to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid any last-minute difficulties. Similarly, Institute and District Nodal Officers are advised to complete the verification process within the stipulated timelines to facilitate timely processing and disbursement of scholarships.

\*\*\*\*\*

RRTN

report_json.title: For NMMSS academic year 2026–27, verify the lat...
report_json.research_question: For NMMSS academic year 2026–27, verify the latest application deadline and the upcoming Institute (L1) and District (L2) verification deadlines. Check whether any official notice after October 15, 2026 changed those dates. Compare the October 15 and October 1 notices with the original August schedule. Keep application and verification dates separate, flag superseded dates as outdated rather than conflicting, and leave required documents or renewal criteria unconfirmed unless an official source states them. Do not add state exam dates.
report_json.executive_summary: As of October 31, 2026, the NMMSS application deadline for the 2026–27 academic year is confirmed as October 31, 2026. This is an extension from the original August 31, 2026, deadline stated in early August communications. Consequently, all verification deadlines have also shifted: the Institute (L1) verification must be completed by November 15, 2026, and the District (L2) verification by November 30, 2026 (superseding the original September deadlines). Both the October 1st extension notice and the October 15th Ministry workshop report corroborate these updated dates. No official notices dated after October 15, 2026, were found in the provided sources to suggest further changes. While eligibility (Class VII marks/income) and the scholarship amount (₹12,000) are confirmed, the specific list of required documents and the detailed academic criteria for renewal remain unconfirmed and require manual verification.

report_json.title: Gnani AI Great Indian AI Internship Challenge 2026 Verification Report
report_json.research_question: Comprehensive verification of eligibility, stipend, deadlines, technologies, selection stages, conditional nature, and team rules for Gnani AI's 2026 challenge.
report_json.executive_summary: Gnani AI's 'Great Indian AI Internship Challenge' is an open 6-week build contest closing on November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM IST. It offers up to 100 six-month paid internship positions starting January 1, 2027, with stipends advertised up to ₹1,00,000 per month, alongside ₹5,00,000 in ten dedicated category awards. Participation is open to enrolled students aged 18+ in India, building individually or in teams of up to two. Applications must incorporate Gnani AI models (Prisma v2.5 ASR, Timbre v2.0 TTS, or Evon v3.3 LLM) and publish a public demo video on LinkedIn or X. Crucially, the internship is NOT guaranteed upon submission; candidates are shortlisted via social engagement verification and technical review, followed by individual interviews.
